capabilityMatrix.note: The canary builds the upstream qpdf executable rather than reimplementing PDF operations in JavaScript.
Chromium smoke validates a deterministic one-page PDF fixture and performs a real PDF rewrite.
The canary smoke rewrites a generated PDF with --linearize and validates the result.
QPDF's built-in native crypto provider is compiled without OpenSSL/GnuTLS.
Browser execution stages explicit files in Emscripten MEMFS.
The initial QPDF browser canary is single-threaded and does not require cross-origin isolation.

notes: QPDF 12.4.1 is built from the official qpdf-12.4.1.tar.gz release asset and verifies its GitHub-published SHA-256 before extraction.
The reviewed v12.4.1 annotated tag peels to exact upstream commit c37f83ae468abb6cc741f43b2f6fdeb66e550ffb.
Emscripten 6.0.8 port inputs are pinned as zlib 1.3.2 and libjpeg 9f; their source hashes and distribution notices are carried into the release build.
The browser smoke starts from a deterministic one-page PDF fixture and verifies check, linearize, AES-256 encryption, decryption and final validation.
Automatic upstream promotion and npm publication remain disabled until separate reviewed PRs.

integration.summary: Self-host qpdf-core.js/qpdf-core.wasm plus the Zoo wrapper, stage PDF files in MEMFS, then execute ordinary qpdf CLI arguments locally in a Worker.
integration.example:
<script src="/vendor/qpdf/browser-qpdf.js"></script>
<script type="module">
const qpdf = WasmZooQpdf.loadHosted({ baseUrl: "/vendor/qpdf/" });
try {
  const input = new Uint8Array(await (await fetch("/input.pdf")).arrayBuffer());
  const result = await qpdf.exec(["/input.pdf", "/output.pdf", "--linearize"], {
    files: [{ name: "/input.pdf", data: input }],
    outputs: ["/output.pdf"]
  });
  console.log(result.files[0]);
} finally {
  qpdf.dispose();
}
</script>
notes: No SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation is required for browser-full.
The wrapper preserves QPDF's CLI argument model and adds only MEMFS file staging plus stdout/stderr capture.
Native host filesystem access is not available; files must be staged into MEMFS.
